measured_at: 2026-11-07T22:46:00Z to 2026-11-07T23:00:00Z (Run 3 full acceptance on BFF 9a46cd188 / FE 4759795f3) and 2026-11-08T14:46:52.055Z to 2026-11-08T14:46:58.469Z (E5 normal un-intercepted /management/alerts browser load + intercepted timeout_fallback + restored normal load on FE 4759795f3 / BFF 21cbd9987)
measured_by: Human/Ops through a real admintest login on the hosted dev environment (Antigravity recorded the operator's staged hosted acceptance findings in git without rerunning hosted checks or accessing any VM/SSH)
operator_acceptance_text:
Pair: BFF 9a46cd188 (container GIT_SHA equal) and FE 4759795f3, deploy run https://github.com/ajoe734/pantheon/actions/runs/42416671176 success at 22:45Z. It contains BFF-ANOMALIES-OPEN-ONLY (#7014), BFF-ALERTS-CURRENT (#7016), BFF-AI-LOOP-HEALTH (#7022), BFF-AI-CURRENT-STATE (#7024), BFF-AI-FLEET-INBOX (#7031), BFF-AI-INBOX-OWNER (#7036) and execute-plans #959.
E1 pass: the pair above, read from the public deployment.json and the container.
E2 pass: 30 consecutive GET /bff/alerts through the admintest login gave 30 bff_composed ok, 0 timeout_fallback, 395-2356 ms. Each read returned 2 alerts: a critical alert for the open incident infra-bff-c0c7d46419976f1c51db4581 and a critical runtime alert for the current runtime rt-4b73b71a. The retired failed runtimes rt-fae0166d, rt-0354501c and rt-43344296 never appear.
E3 pass: the question 目前 12 個 loop 的健康狀況如何？有哪些不正常？只要查詢，不要做任何變更。 was asked in the panel at 22:46Z. Full verbatim answer text and contemporaneous owner responses from run3/accept_result.json, accept.out, accept_surfaces.json and surfaces2.out are recorded below and reconciled claim-by-claim in claim_table. 12 of 12 accepted and overall ok matches /bff/v5/loop-health (12 rows, 12 accepted); 11 ready and 1 ok (telemetry_reconciliation) matches the downstream statuses exactly; telemetry 4 bindings evaluated with 0 skipped and capital_pool_execution 4 of 4 match the 4 active runtimes; bff_health 33 of 33 matches; 2 critical active alerts (1 incident, 1 runtime) matches /bff/alerts. No healthy paper_running persona was called degraded and no retired runtime was called a current failure. The non-stream ask context for the same caller showed trading pulse 4 current runtimes and 138 retired, alerts 2 critical, human_inbox total 1 equal to GET /bff/management/human-inbox (1 item), anomalies 2, persona_fleet 10 current personas (paper_running 4, research_only 3, draft 3) with 140 retired and healthy 4, degraded 0, critical 0, which equals /bff/personas. Surfaces: management_cockpit ok, trading_pulse ok, portfolio_book ok, loop_health ok, persona_fleet degraded.
E4 pass: the real open incident infra-bff-c0c7d46419976f1c51db4581 (high) appears in the answer as 1 incident alert, and the alert count of 2 matches the feed. Run 1 at 12:10Z also passed E4, with incident agent-2e0cc89b4ea8-0001.
E5 pass: on the accepted cohort (FE 4759795f3 / BFF 21cbd9987, linear dev descendant of 9a46cd188 containing all 7 source tasks), an un-intercepted browser load of /management/alerts returned HTTP 200 (meta.surfaces.alerts status=ok, source=bff_composed) and rendered the 2 real active critical runtime alerts (alert-runtime-rt-d21716b9 and alert-runtime-rt-ad81501b) matching the contemporaneous /bff/alerts feed; with the timeout_fallback payload intercepted in the browser, the page showed 暫時無法取得警報資料。 (unavailable_visible=true, healthy_empty_visible=false, 0 rows); restoring normal load again rendered the real result (alerts_normal_restored=true). In run 2 a normal healthy empty load showed 目前沒有警報。. In run 3 the page's own first load hit a real read_timeout (BFF log: bff.alerts degraded fallback: read_timeout, once in 31 reads in 40 minutes) and the page showed the unavailable state, not an empty list.
E6: no password or token was written anywhere, and unverified claims (specifically the verbatim stale-cache wording 「另 BFF 管理資料由快取提供並標記 stale/degraded，因此結論信心為 partial。」 as well as per-loop sub-metric counts not expanded in the compact rows_detail tuple projection) are explicitly named.
History: run 1 at 12:10Z on 004a9a4ec found that persona_fleet always raised a RuntimeError and that the inbox read the wrong layer, which became BFF-AI-FLEET-INBOX. Run 2 at 15:15Z on 1e4bc7ce5 found that an empty approval queue was called unavailable and that empty open incidents counted as degraded, which became BFF-AI-INBOX-OWNER. Run 3 passed.
Limitations: persona_fleet stays degraded because the existing rule marks a persona whose sessions, teaching sessions, allowed actions, strategies or bindings are empty as degraded, which is normal for draft and research_only personas; this is out of scope and was reported to the operator. The answer's phrase about stale cache is unverified. The alerts route can still time out at its 3.0 second budget under page-load fan-out, but the page shows that honestly.
